Azoreductase producer Purification steps References
Shewanella xiamenensis BC01 • Recombinant AzrS collected via centrifugation [50]
• Sonication
• Centrifugation
• His-Trap affinity chromatography
• Elution with sodium phosphate buffer
Bacillus licheniformis • Harvested cells were treated with Lysozyme [39]
• Lysate clarified by centrifugation
• Supernatant was added with ammonium sulfate
• Ion-exchange chromatography
• Affinity chromatography
Shewanella sp. Strain IFN4 • Membrane bound azoreductase [14]
• Crude extract subjected to (NH4)2SO4 precipitation
• Desalt via desalting column PD-10
Halomonas elongate • Ion Exchange (Q-Sepharose Fast Flow) [26]
• E.coli (BL 21 and Rosetta-gami) transformed
• Transformed bacteria was harvested via centrifugation
• Sonication
Chromobacterium violaceum • Centrifugation and supernatant loaded on Ni column [43]
• Elution of protein with 100mM imidazole
• Buffer exchanged to remove imidazole
• Culture centrifuged; sonication with lysing buffer
Bacillus wakoensis A01 • Centrifugation; supernatant loaded on column [34]
• Elution with elution buffer (Imidazole in PBS)
